# Phase 3 — HTTP API and Request Lifecycle

Follow Copilot instructions. Read API Contract, OpenAPI, lifecycle, error handling and relevant data model specs. Implement HTTP server/router, schema validation, endpoints for request submission, retrieval, cancellation, health as contract requires; request ID/correlation, idempotency, structured error envelope, lifecycle transitions, bounded timeouts, cancellation, graceful shutdown. Do not introduce auth assumptions not approved; protected operations must not be exposed insecurely—if authentication choice is unresolved, implement a clearly isolated interface and report blocking decision. Add unit/contract/API tests and ensure OpenAPI conformance. Acceptance: transitions are enforced, malformed requests rejected, idempotency behavior deterministic, cancellation tests pass, no claim of completed request before work concludes.
